name: toned-image
title: Toned Image
description: Any picture turned into a manga screentone: black and white, dark areas become dense dots or lines in ink, light areas stay paper. Patterns: dots (45° screen), lines, cross, noise. Settings: density (cell size in px), contrast, threshold (solid ink above a darkness level). Done with CSS only (blend modes, filters, radial and linear gradients, a feTurbulence noise tile as background): same look in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, cross-origin pictures work, nothing uploaded. Ink is the foreground colour, paper the background; dark mode is the negative. Keeps alt text.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/toned-image". The TonedOptions type is exported too; Avatar's toned option uses TonedImage with those options.

meta.tagline: A photo turned into a screentone, in your browser.
meta.usage:
import { TonedImage } from "@/components/manga/toned-image"

<TonedImage src="/city.jpg" alt="A city at dusk" pattern="dots" density={6} className="aspect-[4/3] w-full border-ink" />

props.name: src / alt
props.description: The picture and its text alternative (kept). Same-origin, data: or blob: URL.

props.name: density
props.description: Cell size in px: smaller is a finer screen. Blur and screen scale with it.

props.name: contrast
props.description: Above 1 pushes shadows and lights apart.

props.name: threshold
props.description: 0 is off. Above 0, more of the picture goes solid ink (dark areas first).

props.name: className
props.description: Sets the size and the frame, e.g. aspect-[4/3] w-full border-ink.
